title: Rah Cashiano - Toxic
htmlContent:
Rah Cashiano's "Toxic" is that brilliant level of music that shows how much life music has. It excels at bringing every element that makes music great into one song, with each element complimenting the next. The song is vocally amazing, as well the produced to perfection to make a must hear record for the world to enjoy.

He sets the perfect tone with his innovative style of producing, that’s packed with engaging synths that makes lights come out of your speakers. The vocal performance is a match made in heaven with the music, with his singing guiding the way for this new world he brings to you.
